text:
maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to clarify async batching behavior in model cards and add SDK snippet migration notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421
ajay: Nice. Can you drop the PR number in the thread and which files changed?
maria: PR #7421. Changes: model-catalog/limits.md (seq tables), model-cards/nebula3b.md (compat note), model-cards/polaris13b.md (benchmark row), and examples/sdk-migration.md (v3 -> v4 snippets). Branch: docs/card-async-batch-clarify.
sasha: I can sanity-check the bench numbers. Which workloads did you base the defaults on?
maria: Default batch_window values in the doc are 20ms for Dedicated pools and 10ms for Hosted (we saw different perf curves in small internal runs). Also call out cold-start penalty for quantized edge variants.
olivia: Minor nit — the SDK snippet still shows the old client.call() signature. We should surface the v4 client.generate() example and a tiny migration note: `batch_window` units changed to milliseconds.
ben: Also, wording in the example response implies a deterministic token count. Let's avoid exact token numbers — use "~<n> tokens" or "approx tokens".
sasha: Quick bench notes (raw):
```
polaris13b fp16 | batch_window=20ms | batch=4 => median p50=45ms, p99=120ms
nebu3b q4_0   | cold start first request => +80ms, steady => ~40ms
Notes: batching reduces p50 but adds tail if window too large for low qps.
```
docbot: lint-check: missing anchor link for `batch-window` cross-reference in model-catalog/limits.md — see docs-lint failure in CI.
maria: I'll add the anchor. Olivia — can you update the snippets to v4 and add the migration callout?
olivia: Yep — updating now. I'll include both minimal v3->v4 side-by-side examples and a short TL;DR. Also adding a one-line note about CPU fallback for quantized models.
ajay: After snippets updated, I can review. One request: add a short compatibility line under each card: "CPU fallback allowed? yes/no; quantized determinism: low/medium/high" — keeps downstream teams from assuming parity.
maria: Good idea — added a small table row to the Nebula and Polaris cards. Pushed an update to the PR with anchor + snippets + table row.
ben: Quick copy pass: fixed grammar on line 84 and changed "tokens: 42" -> "tokens: ~42" in the examples.
ajay: Reviewed the latest diff, looks good. Approving pending CI green.
maria: CI passed, merging now.
deploy-bot: docs-site build started (sha: d4c3b2a)
deploy-bot: docs-site build SUCCEEDED — https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/7421 :sparkles: 
maria: Thanks everyone — if you notice any downstream SDK examples broken by the migration note, ping me and I'll open a follow-up.
ben: Nice! small follow-up: add a sentence in the migration guide clarifying that `batch_window` is a client-side hint and can be overridden by routing policies.
maria: Added a one-liner, will patch if we get more feedback.
